size.$description: Web type scale in px (build converts to pt for print at ×0.75). Hangul-first sizing: floors come from Korean legibility, Latin rides along.

leading.$description: Korean floors: body ≥1.5, display answers to a 1.2 floor instead — forcing 1.5 onto display Hangul is a setting error, not compliance.

radius.$description: Two radii, not one. A single radius everywhere is a listed slop tell (gate 0).

duration.$description: Motion QUALITY only — choreography (what moves when) is prose in DESIGN.md, never a token (ENGINE §3).
